settings.title: Grow lights for dark corners.
settings.content: Corner plants often look right in the room but sit outside the best natural light. The setup should bring light to that exact spot.

settings.title: The corner problem
settings.content: Light can fall off quickly in corners, especially behind furniture or away from windows.

settings.title: Recommended setup
settings.content: Consider pendant, spotlight, or flexible setups that can reach the plant without cluttering the corner.

settings.title: Soliseed corner grow light
settings.content: A flexible option for larger plants and low-light corners.

settings.title: Setup tips
settings.content: Aim the light at the plant canopy, keep access for watering, and avoid placing cables where people walk.

settings.title: Can a dark corner become a plant spot?
settings.content: Often yes, if the setup can safely and consistently bring light to that corner.

settings.title: Bring light to the corner where the plant belongs.
settings.content: Positioning matters as much as the light itself.
